title: Planning data serialization
responsibility: Serialize planning records consistently, hash content and create coded failures.

inputs.name: hash.value
inputs.description: Text or bytes to hash with SHA-256.

inputs.name: json.value
inputs.description: JSON-compatible value to serialize with a trailing newline.

outputs.name: planData
outputs.description: Serialized value with sorted object keys, omitted undefined object properties and preserved array order.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Never returns; throws an Error carrying code and path null.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: Serialized record followed by a newline.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Current time as an ISO timestamp.

outputs.name: parse
outputs.description: Parsed JSON cast to the requested type; no schema validation is performed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: parse reports artifact-corrupt for invalid JSON; fail throws the supplied code and message.
